## Lettered steps

Use the `groovyAlpha` class to show substeps as lettered circles:

1. Open the product in your browser and log in.
1. Select **New Session** and do these steps:

    <ol class="groovyAlpha">
      <li>Give your session a name.</li>
      <li>In the **Editor** field, select an IDE.</li>
      <li>Select **Launch**.</li>
    </ol>

1. Use the new session.
